title: Unweighted approximate tangent spaces a.e. on a finite-measure subset of a C¹ cover (Simon 3.1.6 ⇒)
statement: Let n ≥ 1, ℓ ∈ ℕ and Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^{n+ℓ}. Let C be a Borel set with Hⁿ(C) < ∞, Z a set with Hⁿ(Z) = 0, and (N_k)_{k∈ℕ} sets with IsC1Submanifold n (N_k) and Hⁿ(N_k) < ∞ for every k, such that C ⊆ Z ∪ ⋃_k N_k. Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ C there is a subspace P that is the approximate tangent space of C at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.4 (Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x P).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (C Z : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (N : ℕ → Set (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet C → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) C < ∞ → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) Z = 0 → (∀ k, IsC1Submanifold n (N k) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (N k) < ∞) → C ⊆ Z ∪ ⋃ k, N k → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)), x ∈ C → ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x P
